"AI" Reads Human: Human Language Encoding at Machine Speed and the Energy Cost

When two machines talk in text formats designed for human eyes, they burn up to two thousand times more chip energy.

[Up to 2,054x Extra Chip Energy Reading Human Text]

1/3 Computers often swap data in text formats written for human eyes, forcing machines to spend extra energy reading them back.

2/3 Reading indented configuration text took over two thousand times more chip energy per record than reading compact machine numbers directly.

3/3 Chopping text into AI word pieces burned twelve times more chip energy than parsing the text, before any model ran.

Energy class: reported_j (280.40 nJ chip counter; board_metered=false, never mixed with shunts).
